items.title: Spider Flying a Small Kite
items.alt: One spider holds a tiny kite reel with its two front legs while six legs stand below; one continuous line leads to a simple kite.
items.description: One spider holds a tiny kite reel with its two front legs while six legs stand below; one continuous line leads to a simple kite. Useful for outdoor story cards.

items.title: Spider beside an Apple Slice

items.title: Spider Under a Mushroom

items.description: One spider rests beneath one broad red mushroom cap, all eight legs visible beside the short stem. Useful for woodland storytelling.
